spans.s:
lāñchana (EI 28), an emblem. Cf. cihna.
 (EI 9), the [royal] emblem; cf. Tamil lāñjanai-pper̤u, lāñjinai-pper̤u, ilāñjai-pper̤u (SITI), the royal seal.
 (CII 3, etc.), a crest as distinguished from dhvaja or a banner. Cf. cihna.
 (HA), the distinguishing mark or symbol of a Jina image, which helps one to identify the different Jinas.
